ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) background with a high frequency of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, creating a roughly 60:40 dark-to-light ratio across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive salt-and-pepper mottling across both lobes. High-intensity white clusters are concentrated heavily along the trailing edge and distal tips, transitioning to finer, discrete speckling toward the center of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees, providing a clear division between the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Continuous saw-tooth peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude variance of 5-15 pixels. Significant jagged indentation on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in blunt, barnacle-encrusted points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast, globular yellowish-white clusters localized at the tips and along the trailing edges of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular traumatic indentation/tissue loss on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of white micro-spotting across the entire visible ventral surface, creating a distinctive speckled texture.
